name: principia
summary: The launchpad your repositories write for themselves

tasks.title: Add per-task "work on this" actions (repo tasks + board focus)
tasks.notes: tasks[].agent + {{TASK_TITLE}} substitution + a generic fallback prompt, so every task is immediately actionable from the launchpad.

tasks.title: Show real Claude Code session history in the Agents tab
tasks.notes: Reads ~/.claude/projects/<repo>/*.jsonl directly (title, turns, branch). Gated to repos with a committed .principia/repo.json. Per-row reveal/copy/Resume, per-repo continue-latest/new. Also fixed: data-task/data-resume clicks were dead (missing from the click selector).

tasks.title: Density pass: compact rows everywhere, no hover-only actions
tasks.notes: Row actions used to crossfade in on hover, so every action was invisible until moused over and the slot read as dead space. Now meta and actions sit side by side, always visible, across every tab. Paddings/line-heights tightened globally. Dropped the hover-only icon-morph in Setup for a real button.

tasks.title: Fix runner invocations: submit the prompt and stay interactive
tasks.notes: All four were wrong. claude used --append-system-prompt (opens an idle session, never submits). codex --prompt-file does not exist. gemini -p and agy --prompt are headless. agy has no run subcommand. Now positional/-i/--prompt-interactive everywhere.

tasks.title: Give every walkthrough step an agent prompt
tasks.notes: New focused prompts declare-flows/add-agent/track-tasks in prompts/, run through one allowlisted runPrompt() (the webview names an id, never a path). setupRepo and planBoard were near-identical copies of that and now delegate to it. Added {{CONTRACT_ROOT}}/{{SPEC}}/{{VALIDATE}} so committed prompts carry no machine paths.

tasks.title: Wire the MCP server into setup for every runner
tasks.notes: principia init now installs mcp/ deps, proves the server starts with a real JSON-RPC handshake, then registers it with claude/codex/gemini using each CLI's own syntax. All five prompts now tell agents to prefer write_repo_contribution/write_board over hand-editing. Also disabled the project-scoped .mcp.json copy, which could never start (CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT is plugin-only).

tasks.title: Give declared flows the full card width
tasks.notes: Flow chips were inside the row's middle column, competing with git meta and actions, so they stacked one per line and wrapped mid-label while half the row sat empty. Now a full-width strip below the row, one line per chip, with the primary flow marked and ports shown.

tasks.title: Give the CLI real terminal presentation
tasks.notes: New zero-dependency cli/src/ui.js: colour, wrapped labels and details with hanging indents, aligned help, a copyable quote block, elapsed time. Degrades correctly under NO_COLOR, a pipe and TERM=dumb, where the glyph and words still carry the meaning.

tasks.title: Link tasks to the conversation they started in
tasks.notes: Principia picks the session id before launching (claude/gemini --session-id), so the link is certain rather than guessed from whichever transcript appeared after. Resuming reopens it. Ids are machine-specific, so they live in the gitignored .principia/local.json — its first real use — never in committed repo.json.

tasks.title: Stop tabs going stale until a forced refresh
tasks.notes: The board was never watched at all: a bare **/ glob only covers open workspace folders, so ~/.principia/board.json changed unnoticed. Added absolute watchers for it and for .git/HEAD and index, coalesced at 250ms. Poll cut 120s->15s, affordable because session transcripts are now cached by mtime (7.7MB, 30ms -> free) and device probes have a 10s TTL.

tasks.title: Show the last commit subject on repo rows
tasks.notes: git log -1 already fetched the subject and discovery.js kept it, but no view ever rendered it — collected and thrown away every refresh. Now shown beside the repo name, shrinking to an ellipsis so a long message never pushes the chips onto a second line.

tasks.title: Give MCP agents the full contract, not just the schema
tasks.notes: Server-level instructions carry the workflow and the judgement calls (detection first, empty flows is valid, never done without evidence, writes replace) for agents that never see prompts/. Also closed a real gap: tasks[].agent, links[] and generatedFrom existed in the schema and validator but not in the MCP input schema, so an MCP agent could not set them at all.

tasks.title: One action: open the workspace and pick up the last session
tasks.notes: Replaces open-in-new-window. Prefers a .code-workspace (now detected on disk, not only when recents happened to record one), opens it, then opens a terminal and resumes the repo latest session. The new window has its own extension host, so the intent is handed over via a one-shot, TTL-bounded ~/.principia/pending.json. Repo rows show a session count; activity rows with a session id resume it.

tasks.title: De-duplicate the runner table shared by the extension and the CLI
tasks.notes: shared/runners.js is now the only copy; extension/ and cli/ re-export it. The CLI only ever used detect(), so ~110 of the 165 duplicated lines were dead weight there. The roster is still spelled out in the schema, validator and MCP server on purpose (a schema cannot import code; those tools are dependency-free), so scripts/check-runners.js fails if the six lists disagree — verified by injecting drift.

tasks.title: Ordered getting-started walkthrough on the Setup tab
tasks.notes: Six steps in the order the product works: runner, repo opts in, declares flows, ships an agent, tracks tasks, plans across repos. Completion is derived from live data, never stored, so it un-completes if a contribution is deleted. Nothing auto-collapses — that was the rejected design.

tasks.title: Label git state instead of glyphs
tasks.notes: "main ●17 ↑8" is unreadable without knowing the convention. Now "17 uncommitted" / "8 unpushed" / "3 behind" with a branch icon and tooltips, shared by Repos, Recents and Setup.

tasks.title: Toggle to hide finished tasks
tasks.notes: A filter strip on the Tasks tab, remembered across reloads in webview state alongside the tab and search filter. It carries its own data-sec so the patching renderer replaces it — without that the button would keep a stale icon after each toggle. Hiding everything falls back to a real empty state rather than a blank tab.

tasks.title: Toggle to hide task descriptions
tasks.notes: Collapses every task to its title, remembered across reloads. The filter strip is no longer gated on there being finished tasks, or this second button would have been unreachable whenever nothing was done yet.

tasks.title: Two columns when there is room, one when there is not
tasks.notes: CSS columns rather than a grid: a grid row is as tall as its tallest member, which is why the earlier 2-column card grid was rejected. Columns have no rows, so each card keeps its own height. Rail-less tabs split at 1000px, tabs with a rail at 1550px since 280px is already spoken for; hero and filter strips span both columns.

tasks.title: Stop the layout rule inflating every row
tasks.notes: .main, .rail { gap: 10px } also matched the <div class="main"> nested inside every row, adding 10px between each title and its meta line. That was real height no amount of padding tuning could explain. Scoped to .content > .main.

tasks.title: Make principia-cli publishable to npm standalone
tasks.notes: cli/ depends on spec/, prompts/, scripts/validate.js living in the parent checkout. Needs bundling at pack time or a separate principia-contract package.

tasks.title: De-duplicate MCP server validation from scripts/validate.js
tasks.notes: mcp/src/lib.js hand-keeps a copy of the contract validation rules. A future schema change has to be applied in both places.

tasks.title: Test the extension's zero-state install on a second machine
tasks.notes: Only ever tested against the dev machine's real 16 discovered repos, never a genuinely empty install with zero prior Principia state.

tasks.title: Bundle shared/ when packaging the extension and CLI
tasks.notes: extension/ and cli/ now require ../../shared/runners, which resolves fine from a checkout and from the dev symlink. A .vsix built from extension/ alone, or a standalone npm publish of cli/, would not include it — the same packaging gap as cli-npm-publish.
